text: Persistent flags are collected by `updateParentsPflags`, and `mergePersistentFlags` adds both the current command's `PersistentFlags()` and the collected `parentsPflags` to `c.Flags()` (`command.go:1847-1855`). A lookup through `persistentFlag` checks the current command first, then updates and searches the parent persistent-flag set (`command.go:1805-1816`).
